# Xcode template fixture

`expo-sdk58.pbxproj` is the unmodified `ios/HelloWorld.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj` from the official npm package `expo-template-bare-minimum@58.0.29` (SDK 58 tag), retrieved 2026-10-28. Attribution is in `EXPO-LICENSE`.

This small fixture lets Windows developers test the config plugin's Xcode mutations without claiming to run Expo prebuild or compile Swift. The actual generated project is separately checked in Linux CI and can be compiled with the manual macOS workflow.
